description: Ministry of Labour,Trade Union Relations  - The Collective Agreement entered into between Nestle Lanka Plc and the Ceylon Mercantile Industrial and Genaral Workers' Union
reasoning: This gazette content publishes a collective agreement between a private company (Nestle Lanka PLC) and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions governing employment terms, working conditions, wages, benefits, and dispute resolution procedures. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory framework for industrial relations, published in accordance with statutory authority.
